domain_notes: fulfillment_status maps (ordered, shipped) to one of {pending, completed, partial}. The partial branch is the fallthrough return reached only when 0 < shipped < ordered. Both existing tests hit the boundaries (0 shipped, all shipped); neither exercises a partial shipment, so the fallthrough is untested.
rationale: Selected fulfillment_status because its fallthrough 'partial' return is the sole enforcement of the not-completed-when-partial rule and no test covers it.
